seattle-pacific-northwest-cascade-loop-a.speedBand: 50–80 km/h riding core, local limits always win

sections.advice: This Scenic stretch in Cottage Lake → High point near Issaquah stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

Photo stop near Lakeland North → Boulevard Park is the technical section. Hairpins, gradients and mixed traffic can stack up quickly; use low drama inputs, stay wide of centre lines and expect buses or riders appearing exactly where optimism says they will not.
